text:
it likely taking a few weeks to months for a reply, then another few months for the first appointment. its not recommended to travel meanwhile. but you can ask of course MH if they would issue your partner a re-entry visa for her visa (i assume tourist visa currently?), they dont have to issue it though. 
for the documents in english: they were orginally in english or you got them translated in english from another language?
maybe someone who recently did the process in petach tikva can report how long it took them, but just note that each case might be different.
